_provenance: STAR (space-time autoregression) instance on real US state data. W: contiguity of the ILINet-reporting subset of the 48 contiguous states + DC (N=47, 107 undirected edges; dropped no state-level ILINet series: fl; series incomplete over the window: la), derived deterministically from the US Census Bureau county adjacency file https://www2.census.gov/geo/docs/reference/county_adjacency.txt -- two states are neighbours iff some county of one is listed adjacent to some county of the other; W is then row-standardised (STAR/Cliff-Ord convention, bounds the spectral radius at 1). Y: CDC ILINet weekly state-level influenza-like-illness rates (percent of outpatient visits), retrieved from the Delphi Epidata mirror of CDC FluView https://api.delphi.cmu.edu/epidata/fluview/ field `ili`, epiweeks 201540..201739 (T=104 complete weeks); transformed as log(ili + 0.1) and centred per state. Both W and Y are real observed data; nothing is simulated. Built by benchmark/probprog/ablation/pre_lowering/build_star_ili.py.
